_comment: Haus network residences as published on haus.fund (read Sept 1 2026) plus our own planning notes. Names are spelled the way the site spells them. start_date_precision: 'day' = exact date published, 'month' = month only, null = active or in development with no date. Coordinates are absent where the site gives no address; 'campus' means we placed the pin on the named campus, not a street address. profile = how the housing search should read this house: bed range, kitchen rule, and scoring weights.

nodes.name: Punkhaus
nodes.description: The fundraising flagship. Cohort housing, communal kitchen, dry-lab workspace, and the weekly dinners where companies go from angel to seed.
nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: the cohort residence is expected to be the Fitzgerald (620 Post St) from Sept 27, two floors, whole building as next year's aim. That deal was 'being signed' on Aug 20; our data does not confirm a signature.

profile.note: One building for the whole cohort, or two buildings close to each other.

nodes.source: haus.fund/punkhaus (Sept 2026); Ria and Elliot planning call Aug 20 2026

nodes.name: Femhaus
nodes.description: The all-women house. A founder residence blending rigorous scientific work, startup building, and a culture of mutual care and ambition.
nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: 2550 Van Ness (with Minerva University) is being worked for Femhaus or Safehaus; about 10 to 12 women, kitchen required.

profile.note: Small, safe, own kitchen. Calm block matters more than price here.

nodes.name: Alumhaus
nodes.description: The alumni house. Where graduated founders keep building inside the network: extended stays, ongoing community, and the gravitational center of the alumni layer.
nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: alum house operational Sept 1 2026.

profile.note: Longer stays, so monthly price per bed and a real kitchen weigh most.

nodes.name: Safehaus
nodes.description: The biosecurity house. A live-in residency for founders building defenses against engineered pandemics: countermeasures, DNA-synthesis screening, and biosurveillance.
nodes.planning_note: 2550 Van Ness is a candidate for either Femhaus or Safehaus (Aug 20 call).

profile.note: Small secure building with its own kitchen.

nodes.name: Cellhaus
nodes.description: Lab space inside KBIC, the Kobe Biomedical Innovation Cluster, with cohort living space on campus. Bench and bed on the same island. First cohort targeted September 2026 with Frontier Humans, running into Mirai Tech PopUp City on Port Island.

profile.note: Walking distance to KBIC on Port Island. No candidates logged yet.

nodes.name: Pharmhaus
nodes.description: With BioLeap (operated by parallel18), residents get lab space at the Confluence Center in Science City plus cGMP pilot plant access. Cohort housing anchored at Casa Chironja, a beachside coliving compound in San Juan.

profile.note: No map imagery loaded for San Juan yet.

nodes.name: Greenhaus
nodes.description: With Crecimiento, lab and coworking space at +54 Lab inside the Parque de Innovacion, Buenos Aires' science and technology district.

profile.note: No map imagery loaded for Buenos Aires yet.
